deal_value.notes: All-cash ~$422.1M for a 90.1% stake; Mr. Cooper retained 9.9%; press reports framed it as ~$500M enterprise value less ~$31M of adjustments; closed June 30, 2021

calculable.implied_multiple: ~2.2x implied equity value / 2020 revenue (~2.0x on the 90.1% price alone; ~2.4x if the reported $500M EV is used)
calculable.calculation: $422.1M / 0.901 = ~$468.5M implied 100% equity value; $468.5M / $212.1M FY2020 revenue = 2.21x (headline $422.1M / $212.1M = 1.99x; reported $500M EV / $212.1M = 2.36x)
inputs: Purchase price ~$422.1M in cash for 90.1% of Title365 - Blend Labs S-1 (SEC), https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1855747/000119312521194971/d162671ds1.htm and Meritech S-1 breakdown, https://www.meritechcapital.com/blog/blend-ipo-s-1-breakdown
Title365 FY2020 revenue $212.1M - Blend Labs S-1 as summarized by Meritech, https://www.meritechcapital.com/blog/blend-ipo-s-1-breakdown
Announcement and structure (90.1% stake, Mr. Cooper retains 9.9%) - PR Newswire, https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/blend-to-acquire-title365-from-mr-cooper-group-301247317.html
calculable.caveats: FY2020 was a peak mortgage-refinance year, so the revenue base is cyclical (2019 revenue was far lower); calculation uses equity value as EV proxy on a cash-free/debt-free basis; the ~$500M EV figure appears in press coverage but was not independently re-verified against the 8-K

sources.title: Blend to Acquire Title365 from Mr. Cooper Group (PR Newswire)
Blend Labs completed acquisition of 90.1% stake in Title365 from Xome (MarketScreener)
Blend Labs 8-K Q2 2021 press release exhibit (SEC)

notes: Both inputs are firm and from SEC filings: purchase price ($422.1M for 90.1%) and Title365 2020 revenue ($212.1M) are disclosed in Blend's S-1. No source found that explicitly stated the multiple, so verdict is calculable rather than published. Blend later sold Title365 to Covius (announced June 2025), unrelated to this transaction.
